P  Remove distributor cap & rotor.

C  Using SST (G1 and G2 pickups) and a thickness gauge
(NE pickup), measure the air gap between the signal ro-
tor and pickup coil projection.
SST 09240-00020 for G1 and G2 pickups

OK  Air gap:  0.2 — 0.5 mm (0.008 — 0.020 in.)

OK                    NG  Replace distributor housing assembly
